cases.observed: Unauthorized deploy with a credential-like header; no evidence of external token access or misuse.

cases.verification: Authorized owner should check token validity/audience and deployment permission separately without revealing the value. Consider controlled revocation and restricted log-access review only if this is a real exposed credential.
cases.closure: No completion until a fresh permitted deploy and dependent smoke tests run without disclosure.

cases.verification: Protected operator checks expiry versus object access policy, then authorizes a new valid private reference and verifies object signature; do not bypass cryptographic verification.
cases.closure: A fresh correct-head fetch and signature check must execute successfully.
